title: Histone diversity in the archaeal domain of life.
one_liner_zh: 该文利用结构预测和分子动力学模拟系统研究古菌组蛋白多样性及其与DNA的结合模式，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但属于蛋白质-DNA互作的结构建模研究，方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Two-thirds of all archaea encode histones, proteins that are ubiquitously used to structure chromatin in eukaryotes. Archaeal histone sequences are less conserved than their eukaryotic counterparts, and insight into how they structure DNA is limited to a few species that fail to represent the archaeal domain. Here, we use bioinformatics, structure prediction, and molecular dynamics simulations to survey the diversity of histone-like sequences in archaeal genomes and to understand how they might interact with DNA. We identify five distinct types of histones that combine in seven strategies, involving either single histones, multiple histones of the same type, or combinations of types in each genome. Some strategies correlate with environmental pressures and some are phylogenetically restricted. Despite highly divergent sequences, structure predictions and simulations suggest similar histone-DNA binding modes for most strategies. Our work provides a guide to surverying diverse strategies for histone-based DNA organization in archaea.
abstract_zh: 所有古菌中有三分之二编码组蛋白，这些蛋白质在真核生物中普遍用于构建染色质。古菌组蛋白序列的保守性低于其真核对应物，而关于它们如何构建DNA的见解仅限于少数无法代表古菌域物种的研究。在此，我们利用生物信息学、结构预测和分子动力学模拟，调查古菌基因组中组蛋白样序列的多样性，并理解它们可能与DNA相互作用的方式。我们识别出五种不同类型的组蛋白，它们以七种策略组合，涉及每个基因组中的单一组蛋白、同类型多个组蛋白或不同类型组合。某些策略与环境压力相关，而某些则受系统发育限制。尽管序列高度分化，结构预测和模拟表明大多数策略具有相似的组蛋白-DNA结合模式。我们的工作为调查古菌中基于组蛋白的DNA组织多样策略提供了指南。
